---
name: fivem-security-review
description: Use for reviewing or fixing exploitable FiveM server, client, NUI, permission, persistence, or trust-boundary issues.
---

# FiveM Security Review

Check network events/callbacks, client authority, CID/source confusion, permissions and rank hierarchy, routing buckets, distance/entity ownership, duplication, concurrency, replay/idempotency, cleanup, SQL injection, NUI trust, admin boundaries, and secret leakage. Fix root causes server-side, fail closed, and use validation, locks, or transactions; never rely on hidden buttons.
